idea: Build a task manager app where users create tasks, get reminders, upload files, and export reports.

messages.content: Build a task manager app where users create tasks, get reminders, upload files, and export reports.
To help us draft a thorough IEEE-style SRS for your task manager, I’ll ask a few questions about user roles and functional needs—no technical knowledge required. Let’s start with the first question.

analysis_summary: A task manager app for creating tasks, setting reminders, uploading files, and exporting reports.

Where will people use it first?

introduction.purpose: This document specifies the requirements for Task Manager, providing a complete definition of system functionality, user interactions, and technical constraints to guide development and ensure successful delivery of a production-ready task management solution.

product_scope.summary: A comprehensive web-based task management application that allows users to create, organize, and track tasks with file attachments, set automated reminders, and generate exportable reports in multiple formats.
business_objectives: Provide users with an intuitive platform for personal and team task management
Enable efficient organization of tasks with file attachments and deadline tracking
Deliver reliable reminder notifications to prevent missed deadlines
Support data export for analysis and reporting purposes
benefits: Improved personal and team productivity through organized task management
Reduced missed deadlines through automated reminder system
Enhanced collaboration through file sharing capabilities
Data portability through multiple export formats
goals: Deliver a fully functional web-based task manager within 6 months
Support concurrent usage by up to 1000 active users
Maintain sub-2-second response times for all critical operations

product_perspective.system_context: Task Manager operates as a standalone web application accessible through modern browsers, with a RESTful API backend, persistent database storage, and integration capabilities for file storage and notification services.

functional_requirements.title: Task Creation
functional_requirements.description: The system shall allow authenticated users to create new tasks with required fields including title, description, due date, and priority level
acceptance_criteria: Users can successfully create tasks with all required fields completed
Task creation includes validation for date formats and required fields
New tasks appear immediately in the user's task list

functional_requirements.title: Task Editing
functional_requirements.description: The system shall allow task owners to edit existing tasks, modifying any field including due dates, priorities, and descriptions
acceptance_criteria: Users can modify all task attributes except system-generated fields
Edit operations preserve task history and audit trail
Changes are reflected immediately across all views

description_and_priority.description: Comprehensive file management allowing users to attach, view, and manage files associated with tasks

functional_requirements.title: File Upload
functional_requirements.description: The system shall support uploading files up to 25MB in size with support for common document, image, and archive formats
acceptance_criteria: Files up to 25MB are successfully uploaded and attached to tasks
Upload progress is displayed during file transfer
Supported file types are validated before upload

functional_requirements.title: File Management
functional_requirements.description: The system shall allow users to view, download, and remove files attached to their tasks
acceptance_criteria: Users can view attached files within the task interface
File download functionality works for all supported formats
File removal requires confirmation and is logged

description_and_priority.description: Automated notification system that alerts users of upcoming and overdue tasks through multiple channels

functional_requirements.title: Reminder Configuration
functional_requirements.description: The system shall allow users to configure reminder preferences including notification channels and timing
acceptance_criteria: Users can set default reminder timing for all tasks
Notification channel preferences are saved and applied
Custom reminder times can be set for individual tasks

functional_requirements.title: Notification Delivery
functional_requirements.description: The system shall deliver reminders through configured channels including email and push notifications at specified times
acceptance_criteria: Reminders are delivered at the configured time before task deadlines
Notifications include task details and direct links
Delivery failures are logged and retried according to policy

description_and_priority.description: Comprehensive reporting system generating task analytics and supporting data export in multiple formats

stimulus_response_sequences.system_response: The system processes the request and shows a clear status update.
postconditions: The updated result is available for review.

functional_requirements.title: Report Generation
functional_requirements.description: The system shall generate reports showing task completion rates, productivity metrics, and deadline adherence
acceptance_criteria: Reports include completion statistics and trend analysis
Data is presented in clear, readable formats
Reports can be filtered by date range and task categories

functional_requirements.title: Data Export
functional_requirements.description: The system shall support exporting task data in JSON, PDF, and CSV formats for external use
acceptance_criteria: Exports include all relevant task data in the chosen format
JSON exports maintain data structure integrity
PDF exports are properly formatted and readable

performance_requirements.description: The system shall load the main dashboard within 2 seconds for 95% of requests under normal load conditions
Task creation and update operations shall complete within 1 second for 99% of requests
File uploads shall support concurrent operations without significant performance degradation
Report generation for standard time periods shall complete within 5 seconds

safety_requirements.description: The system shall prevent accidental loss of active project work.
safety_requirements.hazard: Loss of project inputs or artifacts

security_requirements.description: All user authentication shall use secure protocols with password hashing and salting
User data shall be encrypted at rest using industry-standard encryption algorithms
All API communications shall use HTTPS with TLS 1.2 or higher
File uploads shall be scanned for malware before storage
User sessions shall expire after 24 hours of inactivity

software_quality_attributes.description: Non-technical users should complete the intake and answer flow without training.

business_rules.description: Tasks without a due date shall not generate reminder notifications
Completed tasks shall remain visible for 30 days before archival
Users can only access and modify tasks they own or are shared with them
File uploads exceeding 25MB shall be rejected with appropriate error messages
Export operations shall include all available data for the selected time period

database_requirements.description: The database shall store user profiles, task data, file metadata, and system logs
Data retention policy shall maintain task history for 2 years after completion
Database backups shall occur daily with point-in-time recovery capability
The system shall support database replication for high availability

internationalization_requirements.description: The product should support future localization without changing the API contract.
locale_rules: ISO date formatting for API payloads

legal_requirements.description: The system shall comply with GDPR requirements for user data protection and right to erasure
Privacy policy shall clearly state data collection, storage, and usage practices
Terms of service shall include acceptable use policy and liability limitations
The system shall maintain audit trails for compliance and security investigations

Error messages shall be user-friendly and provide guidance for resolution
The application shall include comprehensive help documentation and tooltips
System shall support dark/light mode preferences based on user settings
All date and time displays shall respect user's timezone preferences
